cues: The old man is nearly bald, nearly toothless, dressed like a ragpicker, his wings like a buzzard's, dirty and half plucked.
He answers them in an unknown dialect with a sailor's voice, so they sensibly decide he is a castaway.
The neighbour woman, who knows everything about life and death, needs one look: he is an angel, come for their sick child.
Father Gonzaga, the priest, greets him in Latin; he does not understand, and up close he seems much too human.
He writes to his bishop, who will write to Rome.
And the crowd dreams of making him mayor of the world.
text: Pelayo fetches his wife Elisenda. The old man is nearly bald, nearly toothless, dressed like a ragpicker, his wings like a buzzard's, dirty and half plucked. He answers them in an unknown dialect with a sailor's voice, so they sensibly decide he is a castaway. The neighbour woman, who knows everything about life and death, needs one look: he is an angel, come for their sick child. Father Gonzaga, the priest, greets him in Latin; he does not understand, and up close he seems much too human. He writes to his bishop, who will write to Rome. And the crowd dreams of making him mayor of the world.
